title: Account Fare Volume Schedule for Retroactive Claims, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** For a retroactive points claim on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the company's claim fare volume is the total of the fares collected on the company's tickets, placed by collection date, in the claim fare-volume window of 12 calendar months up to and including the claim date. Every fare collection in the fare ledger of the company's tickets under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand counts, whatever the form of payment. The claim fare volume adds a fare-volume uplift:

| Claim fare volume in the 12-month window | Uplift |
|---|---|
| USD 120000 or more | 8 percentage points |
| USD 60000 or more, and below 120000 | 4 percentage points |
| below USD 60000 | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; claim uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the claim points are raised by the total: the uplifted claim points are the claim points multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Boundary rows

| Claim fare volume (USD) | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 59999.99 | nothing |
| 60000.00 | 4 percentage points |
| 119999.99 | 4 percentage points |
| 120000.00 | 8 percentage points |

### Example (hypothetical)

A company whose fare collections in the window total USD 125000.00 claims a segment worth 700 claim points, with no other uplift: 700 multiplied by 108 and divided by one hundred is 756 points.
